 MIDWEST REGION TORCH OF LEARNING: HONORING
SCOTT TUROW
Scott Turow and Jerold S. Solovy (Y1) were honored during a dinner hosted in
Chicago by AFHU's Midwest Region on December 4, 2014. The evening's keynote
speaker was David Makovsky, the Ziegler Distinguished Fellow at The Washington
Institute and a former senior adviser to U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry. Journalist
and comedian Aaron Freeman served as the Master of Ceremonies.
